project: Sprunki 3D Shooter is an intense game where your mission is to shoot Sprunkies and survive for as long as possible. When you run out of bullets, scour the ground for scattered ammo to keep the fight going. Get ready—it’s time to take down some Sprunkies!

1. Use the WASD keys to move and the mouse cursor to rotate the camera.
2. Explore the dangerous foggy alley!
